free_parameters.name: model
free_parameters.why: Model name used only after the target to build OptLM; it does not affect the guard decision

free_parameters.name: path
free_parameters.why: Attempt-relative dummy path containing the harness DUMMY marker so the negative run does not download weights

free_parameters.name: offload_dir
free_parameters.why: Attempt-relative directory so TorchDisk creates its cache outside the repository

free_parameters.name: prompt_len
free_parameters.why: Small fixed prompt length; the guard is evaluated before prompt processing affects the decision

free_parameters.name: gen_len
free_parameters.why: Small fixed generation length used only after the target

free_parameters.name: cut_gen_len
free_parameters.why: Use the repository default rather than truncating generation

free_parameters.name: debug_mode
free_parameters.why: Keep repository default debugging behavior

free_parameters.name: gpu_batch_size
free_parameters.why: Minimum batch size; not involved in the guard

free_parameters.name: num_gpu_batches
free_parameters.why: Minimum number of GPU batches; not involved in the guard

free_parameters.name: percent
free_parameters.why: Valid six-part policy percentages used only after the target

free_parameters.name: sep_layer
free_parameters.why: Use separate layers as in the reference configuration

free_parameters.name: pin_weight
free_parameters.why: Avoid pinned-memory allocation in the CPU-only negative run

free_parameters.name: cpu_cache_compute
free_parameters.why: Use the default non-compute CPU cache mode

free_parameters.name: compress_weight
free_parameters.why: Hold the other compression flag at the value that isolates compress_cache

free_parameters.name: overlap
free_parameters.why: Use the default overlap setting

free_parameters.name: alpha
free_parameters.why: Default grouping factor used only after the target

free_parameters.name: partial_weight_ratio
free_parameters.why: Default partial-weight ratio used only after the target

free_parameters.name: max_num_kv
free_parameters.why: Default KV limit used only after the target

free_parameters.name: verbose
free_parameters.why: Suppress verbose logging while preserving behavior

free_parameters.name: warmup_input_path
free_parameters.why: Repository-relative prompt file available in the checkout and in replay

free_parameters.name: test_input_path
free_parameters.why: Repository-relative prompt file available in the checkout and in replay

execution.entry_reason: The official mha entry is downstream of run_flexgen and never calls it; the guarded branch is only reachable by calling run_flexgen directly.

mocks.reason: run_flexgen loads the Facebook OPT tokenizer before the target, but the model is not cached and the harness is offline; use a deterministic native tokenizer stand-in.
